name: gitloom
description: Long-term memory backed by a real git repository. Recalls what it learned about you in earlier sessions, saves durable facts as they come up, and follows procedures you have taught it.

interface.shortDescription: Long-term memory, stored as markdown in a git repository
interface.longDescription: GitLoom remembers what you tell it across sessions and gives it back when a later question needs it. Memories are markdown in a real git repository, so every one carries its history and what changed it. The plugin adds three tools — recall what is known, save a durable fact, look up a procedure you taught — plus skills for teaching vocabulary and procedures, saving a whole conversation for extraction, and filtered retrieval.
defaultPrompt: What do you already know about me?
Remember that I moved to Pune in September.
Save this conversation to my memory.
How do I ship a release? Check if I have taught you.
